name: OpenRouter Daily Deals
shortDescription: Adaptive OpenRouter model picks and daily deals across the weekly top 200, with optional benchmark intelligence.
description: A dependency-free Chrome extension (MV3) that evaluates OpenRouter's weekly top 200 text models without a provider allowlist. Discovery mode works without credentials and ranks live popularity, request cost, context, discounts and measured provider speed. An optional locally stored OpenRouter key enables Intelligent mode, which adds OpenRouter benchmark evidence for coding, planning, agentic execution, value and critical work. Daily Deals evaluates the full candidate pool and applies a benchmark quality floor when evidence is available. Every card shows live provider pricing, estimated request cost, latency, throughput and Nitro guidance. The key is sent only to OpenRouter's benchmark endpoint; no inference requests, analytics or remote scripts are used.
features: Purpose-specific picks for coding, planning, agentic work, value and critical work
Discovery mode without credentials; optional benchmark-backed Intelligent mode
Daily Deals across all valid models in the weekly top 200, with no provider preference
Live provider quotes: input/output prices, discount percentage, per-request cost
Provider speed via the OpenRouter endpoints API with a public provider-table fallback
Nitro guidance: when the fastest provider is worth the price premium
Exact-slug benchmark matching with evidence dates and honest missing-data handling
Copy the exact model ID and open the model page in one click
Incremental background scanning with alarms, backoff and six-hour refresh
Optional locally stored OpenRouter key; no inference requests, analytics or remote scripts
installInstructions: Download the ZIP and extract it.
Open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Click Load unpacked and select the extracted folder (the one containing manifest.json).
Open the popup — Developer picks is the default tab; the first full scan takes ~12 minutes and refreshes every six hours while Chrome runs.
